{{Quote|The Aii`tkian Anthropologists in Area D-502 have found a new strain of copper thanks to the O.S.S. "Junk Dealers" Guild. The scientists believe the new copper will be used effectively for starship shields and various parts. Local shipwrights tell us it's the answer to their hopes and dreams. 'It has a large range of quality,' says a local shipwright, Tenna Ghii'anna, 'and has a lot of attributes. We'll have to see how it works with our schematics. I'm hopeful, though.'|Imperial Daily News|<ref name="SWG:IDN">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|Imperial Daily News}}</ref>}}
'''Tenna Ghii'anna''' was a [[starshipwright]] who lived in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Aii`tkian Anthropologists]] and the [[O.S.S. D-502 Junk Guild]] discovered a new strain of [[Copper/Legends|copper]] in the Dantooine system's [[Area D-502]]. Aii`tkian scientists then investigated whether it could be used by local shipwrights, such as Tenna Ghii'anna, to manufacture [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts.<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tenna Ghii'anna was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IDN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The document mentioning Tenna Ghii'anna was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:IDN" />
